query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compliance_datasets (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  source_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  version VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'e.g., 2026-01-15, v2.3',
  effective_date DATE NOT NULL COMMENT 'When this version became effective',
  is_current BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE COMMENT 'Is this the current active version?',
  description TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES compliance_sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_source_version (source_id, version)
);
